caption_L2L3: Best Picture winners perform relatively low in box office with only 8 movies achieving higher than $100 million in the box office. Lord of the Rings is the standout box office performer with over $370 million. The Hurt Locker was the worst performing movie with only around $10 million dollars in box office.
